concerns.text: Phase 6 fallback assumes that structural descriptors (coordination number, average bond length, crystal symmetry) can be computed from the raw defect dataset, but the dataset schema (`raw_dataset.schema.yaml`) only includes composition, defect_type, formation_energy, and optional metadata—no crystal structure information. Without structural data, `fallback.py` cannot generate the required descriptors, making the fallback path infeasible. Either extend the raw dataset schema to include structure files/coordinates (e.g., a CIF or POSCAR column) and ensure the Materials Project API fetch retrieves them, or redesign the fallback to use only descriptors derivable from composition.
